C0662.title: Four Men Detained for Extorting Haidilao by Planting Glass Shards in Hot Pot
C0662.summary: In March 2024, several suspects dined at a Haidilao restaurant in Pinggu, Beijing. One of them placed glass shards previously held in the mouth into a sesame sauce bowl and demanded compensation for finding a foreign object. The four suspects formed a group and, within five months, committed similar acts at five Haidilao stores in Beijing, Chengde, and other places, involving more than 10,000 yuan. After police intervened, the suspects were criminally detained on suspicion of extortion.
